recruiterCard.summary: A C++20 price-time-priority matching engine with a crash-safe write-ahead journal and a sequenced TCP order-entry and market-data service.
impactBullets: Built a single-sequencer matching engine with O(1) cancels, partial fills, idempotent request IDs, and SHA-256 state hashing; local matching-core benchmarks reach 8.2M commands/s at 417 ns p99.9.
Added a CRC32C-framed write-ahead journal; in durable mode an order is acknowledged only after fdatasync, with deterministic replay, torn-tail repair, and corruption refusal.
Built a multithreaded TCP server with bounded queues, group commit for durable mode, and gap-free snapshot resync (85.7K req/s in memory with 8 local clients).
Tested with 151 GoogleTest cases, 100-seed property tests against a reference model, fork/SIGKILL crash tests, and ASan/TSan CI.
